units.source_text: 紫夫人一方面是个风雅女子，一方面近来又当了祖母，照顾孙子，无微不至。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was both a woman of refined taste and, lately, a grandmother, caring for her grandchild with the utmost attentiveness.

units.source_text: 无论何事，都办得十全其美，无可指摘，真是个世间难得的完人。

en.t: Whatever she did, she carried it out perfectly and beyond reproach; she was truly a rare, flawless person in this world.

units.source_text: 因此源氏担起心来，他想：“尽善尽美的人，往往寿命不长，世间确有其例。”

en.t: For this reason Genji began to worry, thinking, "People who are perfect in every way often do not live long; there are indeed such examples in the world."

units.source_text: 他竟有些害怕。

en.t: He even felt somewhat afraid.

units.source_text: 他看见过各种各样的女子，但觉得像紫夫人那样众善兼备的人，实在无有其类。

en.t: He had known all sorts of women, but he felt that no one else truly possessed every virtue as Lady Murasaki did.

units.source_text: 紫夫人今年三十七岁。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was thirty-seven years old that year.

units.source_text: 源氏回想多年来和她相处之情，不胜感慨，便对她说：“今年应比往年特别审慎地举行消灾延寿的祈祷。

en.t: As Genji looked back on the affection they had shared over many years, he was deeply moved and said to her, "This year we should perform prayers to avert misfortune and prolong life with even greater care than usual.

units.source_text: 我经常事绪纷忙，不免疏忽遗忘，还望你自己用心留意。

en.t: I am often caught up in many affairs and may neglect or forget things, so I hope you will pay careful attention yourself.

units.source_text: 举行隆重的法会时，你尽管嘱我办理。

en.t: When a grand Buddhist service is to be held, do not hesitate to ask me to arrange it.

units.source_text: 你的舅父北山僧都故世了，实甚可惜！

en.t: It is truly regrettable that your uncle, the Bishop of Kitayama, has passed away.

units.source_text: 平日有事要举行祈祷时，他是最可信赖的一位高僧。”

en.t: Whenever prayers needed to be performed, he was the most trustworthy of eminent monks."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“我从小与众不同，生长深宫，养尊处优。

en.t: Then he continued, "From childhood I was unlike others, raised in the depths of the palace and brought up in privilege.

units.source_text: 今日身居高位，坐享荣华，也是古来少有其类的。

en.t: That I now hold high rank and enjoy such glory is also a rare thing from ancient times to the present.

units.source_text: 然而我所遭受的痛苦，也比别人更多，也是世无其类的。

en.t: Yet the suffering I have endured has also been greater than that of others, and is likewise without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 首先是疼爱我之人，相继亡故。

en.t: First, the people who loved me died one after another.

units.source_text: 到了残生的晚年，又遭逢许多伤心惨目之事。

en.t: Then, in the late years of my remaining life, I encountered many more heartbreaking and terrible events.

units.source_text: 想起了那些荒唐无聊的行为，心中异常烦恼。

en.t: When I think back on those foolish and empty actions, my heart is troubled beyond measure.

units.source_text: 种种违心之事，时刻纠缠我身，直至今日不休。

en.t: All kinds of things contrary to my wishes have constantly entangled me, and they have not ceased even to this day.

units.source_text: 如今我想：我能活到四十七岁，恐是此种痛苦换来的代价吧。

en.t: Now I think that perhaps my living to the age of forty-seven has been paid for with this kind of suffering.

units.source_text: 至于你呢，我觉得除了我流放时别离之苦而外，别无忧伤烦恼之事。

en.t: As for you, I feel that apart from the pain of separation during my exile, you have had no other grief or distress.

units.source_text: 即使身为皇后，身份高贵之极，亦必有忧患之事，其次的人自然更多痛苦。

en.t: Even an empress, though her status is supremely noble, must have troubles and anxieties; those below her naturally have even more suffering.

units.source_text: 例如女御、更衣等高等宫人，交际应酬，处处劳神，与人争宠，烦恼不绝，都是不得安逸的。

en.t: For example, high-ranking palace women such as nyogo and koi must devote care to social obligations, compete with others for favor, and suffer endless worries, so none of them can live at ease.

units.source_text: 你跟了我，好比在父母保护之下的深闺内长大起来一样，这等安逸是别人所盼不到的。

en.t: By being with me, you have lived as though you grew up in a secluded chamber under your parents' protection; this sort of ease is something others cannot hope for.

units.source_text: 即此一端，便见得你的命运比别人好，你知道么？

en.t: From this alone, one can see that your fate is better than other people's; do you understand?

units.source_text: 中间意外地来了这个三公主，固然不免使你感到几分痛苦。

en.t: Of course, the unexpected arrival of the Third Princess must have caused you some pain.

units.source_text: 然而正因此事，我对你的爱情更加深了。

en.t: Yet precisely because of that, my love for you has grown even deeper.

units.source_text: 惟恐这是你自己的事，所以你不易看出，亦未可知。

en.t: Perhaps because it concerns you yourself, it may not be easy for you to see this.

units.source_text: 然而你是深明事理的人，定能了解我的真心吧。”

en.t: But you are someone who deeply understands reason, so surely you can understand my true heart."
